english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the ordinary white colour.

examples.jyutping: gin6 saam1 hai6 baak6 sik1 ge3

english.note: Use 白 mainly for fair or pale skin; light-colored hair is more often described with a separate color word.

examples.english: Her skin is fair, and she hardly tans even in summer.
examples.traditional: 佢皮膚好白，夏天都唔使點曬黑。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 pei4 fu1 hou2 baak6 haa6 tin1 dou1 m4 sai2 dim2 saai3 hak1
